steps.note: Hubs after Kowalczyk was taken in m09: her post copy opens in the van with the aside question; Quintero at the open outer lock explains twice the people. Arakawa's gate call plays once at the split.

said: She turns back to the window.
I'll be in this van. Where else.
notSaid: Kit check. If it opens a door

said: Arakawa steps up beside you at the gate and dials.
She wants a telescope. I'm getting her a telescope.
He wants you on your own. I'll be on this side of the door.
I asked the Council for a second team. They said no.
Two of ours died at the sites nobody covered. Fraser and Ferreira.
Go on. I've got this side.
